summary: Confirmed and regression-tested that Android supports the same compact mobile swipe interactions as iOS: opening/closing workspace drawers, replying to text and direct messages, pulling to refresh conversation history, expanding/collapsing the voice dock, and exiting fullscreen viewing.

checks.name: Workspace drawer and conversation swipes on Android and iOS
checks.observation: All four widget cases passed: edge swipes open and close navigation/member panels, message swipes open reply compose, and pull-down refresh requests another text/DM history page on both iOS and Android.

checks.name: Swipe-to-reply with Android selectable message text
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'mobile message swipes reply and pull down refreshes history (android)'
checks.observation: Android text selection's horizontal-drag recognizer could win the gesture arena before swipe-to-reply. HorizontalSwipeRegion now retains its scroll-aware recognizer and observes pointer completion as a fallback; the test passes without weakening vertical-scroll filtering.

checks.name: Fullscreen viewer downward swipe on Android and iOS
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/screen_fullscreen_overlay_test.dart --name 'mobile downward swipe'
checks.observation: Both platform cases passed; a downward gesture closes the viewer exactly once.

checks.name: Android compact voice dock expand/collapse swipes
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'keeps voice controls in a compact bottom dock on Android'
checks.observation: The Android widget test passed; vertical swipes expand and collapse the dock while preserving the active voice connection.

checks.name: Full Flutter regression and static analysis
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test && flutter analyze
checks.observation: 221 widget/unit tests passed and flutter analyze reported no issues.

checks.name: Release APK build and signature
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter build apk --release && cd .. && /opt/homebrew/share/android-commandlinetools/build-tools/36.0.0/apksigner verify --verbose --print-certs artifacts/android/BOOHTACORD-1.0.0+1-release.apk
checks.observation: The release APK was rebuilt from source revision 3bee888, verified with APK Signature Scheme v2 and the configured upload certificate, and replaced the previous tracked APK at the same path.

checks.name: Physical Android gesture-navigation acceptance
checks.observation: No Android device was attached for checking edge-swipe interaction with the device's system gesture navigation.

remaining: Install/run on an Android phone and verify left/right edge drawer gestures alongside the device's system back/home gestures.
